free_text_notes.physician_note: 52-year-old woman with hypertension, atrial fibrillation, admitted 6/18 with acute decompensated heart failure (EF 30%). Transitioned from IV to oral diuretic yesterday; weight stable. 6/22 12:20: Creatinine rose from 1.4 to 2.1 after diuresis; holding diuretics and rechecking.
free_text_notes.nursing_note: Slept well overnight. Voiding without difficulty. The patient's spouse was present for most of the stay and is well-informed about the care plan. They expressed no concerns and are ready to support the patient at home.
free_text_notes.case_manager_note: Plan is discharge home with son. Patient asked what the new spironolactone 25 mg daily is for; teaching still needed. Earlier pickup was cancelled and rebooked for 14:30 to match the discharge time.
